title.zh: 三维查找界面概念

summary.zh: 创作者把 Apple“查找”的粗略草图交给 Claude，让它制作了一个可交互的三维找钥匙体验。
summary.en: The creator gave Claude a rough sketch of Apple's Find My and had it build an interactive 3D lost-keys experience.

prompt.text:
ROLE
You are a principal frontend engineer, 3D creative developer, and senior product designer specializing in premium interactive experiences.

MISSION
Transform my attached hand-drawn sketch into a polished, functional, interactive 3D application prototype.

The sketch is the source of truth for the interface and product concept. Preserve its core layout, elements, and interactions, but elevate the execution to the quality of a premium consumer app.

Do not simply recreate the drawing as an image. Build a real browser-based prototype that users can interact with.

PROJECT
Build a Find My-inspired 3D experience that helps a user locate a lost set of keys.

01. VISUAL DIRECTION

Create a sophisticated, mobile-first interface with:

- A detailed 3D city environment
- An angled, cinematic map camera
- Procedurally generated buildings, streets, sidewalks, trees, and crosswalks
- Realistic lighting, ambient shadows, and depth
- Smooth camera movement and transitions
- Beautifully designed floating interface cards
- Refined typography and consistent spacing
- Subtle microinteractions and responsive animations

Use a restrained visual language with neutral surfaces, natural greens, and carefully chosen accent colors.

Prioritize visual hierarchy, realism within the chosen art style, and coherent interaction design.

02. CORE USER EXPERIENCE

Implement four connected stages.

STAGE A: MAP VIEW

Show a 3D neighborhood from an elevated perspective.

Display a tracked item marker with a visible location radius.

Add a floating card containing:

Item: Keys
Location: Avenue Marceau
Distance: 14 m
Actions: Play Sound / Find

Make the map interactive with camera rotation, zoom, and smooth transitions.

STAGE B: FINDING MODE

When the user selects Find:

- Animate the camera toward the tracked item
- Highlight a navigational path
- Display directional indicators
- Transition into a closer perspective
- Show an updating distance indicator
- Maintain spatial consistency throughout the animation

STAGE C: NEARBY SEARCH

Create an AR-inspired close-up search experience.

Show a realistic 3D environment with a set of keys resting on a small round table.

Display:

Finding Keys
Distance: 1 m
Animated directional arrow

Make the experience feel like the user is approaching the actual object.

STAGE D: FOUND

Let the user select the keys to complete the search.

Play a subtle success animation, update the interface, and provide an option to restart.

03. INTERACTION REQUIREMENTS

Every visible control must have meaningful behavior.

Implement:

- Interactive camera controls
- Animated item selection
- Functional navigation between stages
- A browser-generated sound preview
- Simulated distance updates
- Interactive object selection
- Back and restart actions
- Loading and transition states

Use deterministic simulated tracking data. Do not claim to access real AirTags, GPS, or Apple Find My services.

04. TECHNICAL STACK

Use:

- React
- TypeScript
- Vite
- Three.js
- React Three Fiber
- Drei
- Motion for UI animations
- Lucide icons
- Modern CSS

Build the environment procedurally.

Avoid paid APIs, API keys, backend dependencies, and external assets that could break the demo.

Keep the code modular, readable, and maintainable.

05. RESPONSIVENESS AND PERFORMANCE

Optimize primarily for a 9:16 mobile viewport while preserving desktop compatibility.

Target smooth animation performance.

Use efficient geometry, instancing where appropriate, controlled pixel ratios, and careful scene cleanup.

Provide accessible controls and respect reduced-motion preferences.

06. DESIGN QUALITY RULES

Avoid:

- Generic dashboard layouts
- Excessive gradients
- Random decorative elements
- Unnecessary floating panels
- Inconsistent component styling
- Abrupt camera transitions
- Fake interactions
- Static screenshots disguised as apps
- Unimplemented buttons

Every visual element should contribute to usability, spatial understanding, or atmosphere.

07. DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS

Deliver a complete runnable project.

Include:

- The full project file structure
- All implementation files
- Complete dependency configuration
- Setup and execution commands
- A short explanation of the architecture
- Clear disclosure of simulated functionality

Do not use pseudocode, unfinished components, or placeholder implementations.

Before finishing, review the code for TypeScript errors, broken imports, missing dependencies, invalid state transitions, and obvious performance issues.

If your environment supports execution, run the application and fix errors.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

The result must allow a user to open a browser, explore a 3D neighborhood, select lost keys, follow an animated navigation experience, locate the keys, and complete the interaction.

It should feel like a cohesive, thoughtfully designed product prototype rather than an isolated visual demonstration.

Start implementing immediately. Make reasonable decisions without asking clarifying questions.

title.zh: 多工具AI视频制作作品
Vault Street 像素风银行劫案微缩场景
title.en: Vault Street pixel-art bank heist diorama

summary.zh: Claude Opus 5.5 制作了一个像素艺术银行劫案立体场景，包含警察追捕、动态交通、昼夜循环、降雨和交互控制。
summary.en: Claude Opus 5.5 built a pixel-art bank-heist diorama with a police chase, moving traffic, day/night cycle, rain, and interactive controls.

prompt.text:
Build a single-file, original pixel-art diorama called "Vault Street": a toy-like bank job on a floating isometric town block, rendered with three.js (r160) at low resolution and upscaled with a post shader (depth outlines, OKLab quantisation to a fixed 64-colour palette, optional Bayer dither, a "Raw 3D" toggle). Orthographic camera, drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, whole-pixel snapping. No weapons anywhere: cartoon robbers in striped shirts, beanies and eye masks.

World: a two-lane loop road (Main St / South St) with curbs, sidewalks, zebra crossings and a parking bay cut into the far side of South St. Inside the block: a columned bank ("ACORN SAVINGS") with a dome, a counter with three teller windows behind glass, a rope line, a manager's desk and a round vault door that rolls aside on a track; everything above knee height is one lid that lifts off while the gang are inside (Auto / Off / On). Also a diner and a park with a fountain. North of Main St: a police station with a beacon, a radio mast, a flag and a three-bay lot (two black-and-white cruisers with red/blue light bars, one impound bay), plus a donut shop with a giant donut on the roof and a hardware store. Street lamps with real lights at night, an alarm bell on a post by the bank, trees, a bus shelter. Day / dusk / night; rain with puddle reflections.

Story loop: a brown sedan waits in the bay → two robbers cross and go in → staff and customers put their hands up → one goes behind the counter and opens the vault → a teller trips the alarm (bell rings, station beacon turns) → four officers run to the cruisers; Car 21 heads for the bank, Car 22 goes the other way and turns across both lanes of Main St → robbers run out with "$" sacks, the sedan pulls out and flees round the block with banknotes fluttering from the boot, Car 21 in pursuit → the sedan stops at the roadblock; hands up, or one runs for the park and gets a flying tackle → cuffs, escorted to the station, the loot carried back through the bank's back door → the cruisers back into the lot, the sedan towed into the impound bay → later the gang make bail and drive back to the bay.

Traffic and people: civilian cars keep their distance (people crossing included), pull over for sirens and give up after a while if nothing passes; cruisers go out over the line to pass. Cars wait at a line while anyone reverses out of or pulls into the lot, and lot moves wait for an empty street. Passers-by walk the sidewalks, step round lamps, wait for cars crossing and sometimes use the bank. No deadlocks, no overlapping vehicles.

UI (English): a lit scoreboard (HEISTS · clock + status · ARRESTS, "LOOT RECOVERED $"), a rail with Time & weather, Bank roof, Units (Car 21, Car 22, Brown sedan, the bank with live status; "Start a heist", Pause, "Heists happen on their own"), a Radio log, View controls; click the bank to start a heist; a "How it's drawn" note. Responsive, light and dark themes.

summary.en: A motion graphic for Jazzy's Burger was made in under 30 minutes with Claude Opus 5.5, without After Effects, templates or keyframes. The creator directed viewers to a Telegram post for the workflow.

title.zh: 代码绘画模型对比

summary.zh: 一组用代码绘画生成的对比作品，比较了Claude Haiku 5.5、Luna 6和Sonnet 5.5的效果，作者指出Haiku 5.5价格比Sonnet便宜很多，并已上线brusharena.art展示。
summary.en: A code-based painting comparison between Claude Haiku 5.5, Luna 6 and Sonnet 5.5, with Haiku 5.5 noted as much cheaper than Sonnet, later shown live on brusharena.art.

summary.zh: 创作者表示 Claude Opus 5.5 帮助改进了游戏，并在后续帖子中分享了 Steam 演示链接。
summary.en: The creator says Claude Opus 5.5 helped improve their game, with a Steam demo linked in a follow-up post.

title.zh: 鹈鹕骑自行车SVG动画

summary.zh: 由Claude Opus 5.5生成的一张SVG插图，展示一只鹈鹉通过甩动来骑自行车。
summary.en: An SVG illustration of a pelican riding a bicycle by whipping it, generated by Claude Opus 5.5.

prompt.text: pelican rides a bicycle by whipping it, in SVG.

title.zh: 浏览器中的3D电子实验台

summary.zh: 一个免费开源、在浏览器中运行的 3D 电子实验台，万用表和电源的表现与真实设备一致。作者使用 Opus 5.5、Three.js 以及 NVIDIA 发布在 Hugging Face 上的 SimReady OpenUSD 素材制作。
summary.en: A free, open-source 3D electronics bench that runs in the browser, with a multimeter and power supply that behave like real ones. It was built with Opus 5.5, Three.js and NVIDIA's SimReady OpenUSD assets from Hugging Face.

title.zh: 通过MCP工具剪辑的赞助宣传片

summary.en: A sponsorship promo video rendered in 25 minutes by Claude Opus 5.5, which was given access to Riverside MCP, Magnific MCP, YouTube Studio and the team's design system, with minimal direction.

summary.en: A sponsored test of Topview's T1 video model, generated with Seedance 2.5-style prompts, with the battle HUD edited by Opus 5.5.

summary.en: A landing page design for Simulithic generated in one shot by Opus 5.5 using an isometric object design skill, with follow-up prompts adding detail interactions like test popups.

title.zh: 吊顶管线碰撞自动重排

summary.zh: Claude Opus 5.5 在一个办公室吊顶示意场景中重新规划了 52 条系统管线，将 78 处碰撞降为零。
summary.en: Claude Opus 5.5 rerouted 52 building-system runs in an illustrative office ceiling scene, reducing 78 clashes to zero.

title.zh: Opus 5.5动画质量演示
泵送机油的机械心脏剖面动画
title.en: Mechanical heart pumping oil with cutaway view

summary.zh: 一段 30 秒的 Blender 动画，展示一颗泵送机油的机械心脏，包含活塞、可打开的外壳、原创配乐和合成音效。作者称 Fable 5.5 在 Claude Code 中仅凭一条提示词，用时 106 分钟完成。
summary.en: A 30-second Blender animation of a mechanical heart pumping oil, with pistons, an opening shell, an original score and synthesized sound effects. The creator says Fable 5.5 made it from one prompt in Claude Code over 106 minutes.

prompt.text: Make a mechanical heart and show its insides, use blender.

summary.en: A short animation made by Claude Opus 5.5 from the casual request to make an interesting anime, which included a self-deprecating joke the creator found charming.

summary.en: ViewsCraft generates video ideas in Minecraft across niches such as horror, history, war, brainrot stories, and crime. The creator is building it with Opus 5.5 and Blender.

summary.en: The creator used a paid service for the creature's shape, then used Claude and Blender to build its skeleton, rigging, weights, and animations.

title.zh: 未说明内容的视频作品展示
用Claude Opus重新剪辑的2007年电影预告片
title.en: 2007 film trailer re-edited with Claude Opus

summary.zh: 作者用自己2007年拍摄的电影母版素材，通过Claude Opus 5.5经过14轮修改意见剪辑并混音制作出这部预告片，ElevenLabs负责配乐和音效制作，Topaz用于画面升级，所有画面均为原始素材，没有生成内容。
summary.en: A trailer re-cut from the creator's own 2007 feature film masters, edited and mixed by Claude Opus 5.5 over 14 rounds of notes, with ElevenLabs creating the hymn arrangement and sound effects and Topaz used for upscaling; all footage is original, none generated.

可互动游玩的主题公园策略游戏

summary.en: A live, playable theme-park strategy game with coasters, log flumes, Ferris wheels and guests, built with Opus 5.5 using assets modeled in Blender and rendered in Three.js.

summary.zh: 作者分享了用 Claude Fable 5.5 测试版本生成的斑马奔跑效果，称这是他得到的最好的一次结果。
summary.en: The creator shares what they call their best output from a Claude Fable 5.5 checkpoint, showing a galloping zebra.

title.en: Fallout 2 mod porting Megaton from Fallout 3

summary.en: A Fallout 2 mod made with Claude Opus 5.5 that ports the Megaton city from Fallout 3, including new trailers and assets created in Blender, with source code shared on GitHub.

summary.en: The creator experimented with editing a video using Claude (Opus 5.5), sharing the result as a casual trial and inviting others to share theirs.

summary.en: A Game Boy-style Magic: The Gathering game with early-era rules, about 158 classic cards, and collectible boosters. The creator says they made it after Opus 5.5 launched, based on a 2023 Reddit concept video.

summary.zh: 这是一个从白天变为黄昏再到夜晚的 Isle Engine 场景。作者表示它运行在自己的引擎和 Claude Code 中，并根据自己的想法提示生成。
summary.en: An Isle Engine scene transitions from day to dusk to night. The creator says it runs in their own engine and Claude Code, prompted from their ideas.
